projects.title: Digital Twin for Urban Heat Island (UHI) Mitigation
projects.description:
Urban areas experience higher temperatures due to buildings, concrete surfaces and limited vegetation, creating Urban Heat Islands (UHIs). I developed a Digital Twin platform that visualizes urban temperature patterns and simulates cooling strategies such as tree planting, green spaces and green roofs, supporting informed decisions for sustainable urban planning.

Technologies Used: Python (Backend), Plotly Dash (Frontend).
